You can turn off trackpad locking in the Settings tab

While esc and right shift — or the Hold to unlock button — are held, the keyboard dims under a big ring in its middle that starts full and empties counter-clockwise over the 2 seconds, with the seconds left counting down inside it. Có khóa trackpad hay không được đặt trong tab Cài đặt mới

notes:
### Added

- Clean keyboard: lock every key for 30 seconds to 5 minutes so you can wipe the keyboard without typing anything, in any app. Brightness, volume, media, Mission Control and Spotlight keys are held too, and the trackpad can be locked as well.
- While cleaning, each key you wipe lights up on the board and is checked for double-typing, so cleaning is a test too. A summary says how many keys were pressed when it ends.
- Unlock by holding the button for 2 seconds, by holding esc and right shift together for 2 seconds, or let the time run out. Touch ID locking your Mac ends cleaning too.
- While cleaning, F1–F12 light up without fn, and ⌘Tab, ⌘Space and other shortcuts macOS takes first can be tested.

### Changed

- Needs Lumi 1.38 or later.

en.headline: Lock your keyboard to clean it without typing anything
items: Lock every key for 30 seconds to 5 minutes so you can wipe the keyboard without typing
Each key you wipe lights up on the board and is checked for double-typing as you clean
Unlock by holding the button for 2 seconds or by holding esc and right shift together
While cleaning, F1–F12 light up without fn and shortcuts like ⌘Tab can be tested
Requires Lumi 1.38 or later

Mỗi phím bạn lau sẽ sáng lên trên bảng và được kiểm tra gõ nhảy luôn
Mở khóa bằng cách giữ nút 2 giây hoặc giữ esc và shift phải cùng lúc
Khi đang lau, F1–F12 sáng mà không cần fn và các phím tắt như ⌘Tab cũng được kiểm tra
Yêu cầu Lumi 1.38 trở lên
